fields.Name: rasa.io - Contact Topics by Newsletter
fields.UserQuestion: What topics is each contact interested in, in each newsletter, and what is their email?
fields.Description: Each contact's topic interests per newsletter, from the topic clouds rasa.io builds from the articles they clicked, with the contact's email and the newsletter's name.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Newsletter_Contact_Topic joined to Contact on contact_id = Contact.id for the email, and to Newsletter for its name. One row per newsletter, contact and topic. Weight is the topic's share of the contact's clicks in that newsletter. Only contacts who have clicked have rows.

fields.Name: IntegrationSchema
fields.Description: The schema that holds the rasa.io tables. Leave it empty for the default, rasa; set it only when the tables were created under another schema.

fields.Name: NewsletterID
fields.Description: The newsletter's id (Newsletter.id).

fields.Name: Newsletter
fields.Description: The newsletter's name.

fields.Name: ContactID
fields.Description: The rasa.io contact id (Contact.id). The same id is used in every rasa.io table, so it links a contact's rows across newsletters.

fields.Name: Email
fields.Description: The contact's email address, from Contact. Use it to match the contact to people in other systems.

fields.Name: Topic
fields.Description: The topic's name.

fields.Name: Clicks
fields.Description: Clicks on articles with this topic, in this newsletter.

fields.Name: Weight
fields.Description: The topic's share of the contact's clicks in this newsletter (0 to 1).

fields.Name: FirstClick
fields.Description: When the contact first clicked an article with this subject.

fields.Name: LastClick
fields.Description: When the contact last clicked an article with this subject.

fields.Name: EffectiveDate
fields.Description: The week rasa.io built this topic cloud for.

fields.Name: rasa.io - Contact Topics Across Newsletters
fields.UserQuestion: What is each person interested in across all our newsletters, by email?
fields.Description: Each person's topic interests rolled up across every newsletter, one row per contact and topic, with the email. Clicks are summed and the strongest weight is kept.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Newsletter_Contact_Topic grouped by contact_id and topic, joined to Contact for the email. Clicks = SUM(num_clicks), Weight = MAX(weight), first/last click widened across newsletters: the same merge rasa.io uses for one contact's topics. Rank a person's interests by Clicks or Weight.

fields.Name: IntegrationSchema
fields.Description: The schema that holds the rasa.io tables. Leave it empty for the default, rasa; set it only when the tables were created under another schema.

fields.Name: ContactID
fields.Description: The rasa.io contact id (Contact.id). The same id is used in every rasa.io table, so it links a contact's rows across newsletters.

fields.Name: Email
fields.Description: The contact's email address, from Contact. Use it to match the contact to people in other systems.

fields.Name: Topic
fields.Description: The topic's name.

fields.Name: Clicks
fields.Description: Clicks on articles with this topic, summed across newsletters.

fields.Name: Weight
fields.Description: The strongest share of clicks this topic had in any one newsletter (0 to 1).

fields.Name: Newsletters
fields.Description: How many newsletters the contact showed this interest in.

fields.Name: FirstClick
fields.Description: When the contact first clicked an article with this subject.

fields.Name: LastClick
fields.Description: When the contact last clicked an article with this subject.

fields.Name: rasa.io - Contact Categories Across Newsletters
fields.UserQuestion: Which broad subject areas is each person interested in across all our newsletters, by email?
fields.Description: Each person's interests at the category level (broader than topics), rolled up across every newsletter, with the email.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Newsletter_Contact_Category grouped by contact_id and category, joined to Contact for the email. Merged the same way as the topic query.

fields.Name: rasa.io - Newsletter Engagement by Contact
fields.UserQuestion: How many opens and clicks has each contact made in each newsletter, and what is their email?
fields.Description: Opens and clicks per contact and newsletter, with the contact's email and first and last activity. Clicks rasa.io judged automated are left out.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Newsletter_Action grouped by newsletter_id and contact_id, joined to Contact for the email (an event's own email can be empty) and Newsletter for its name. Clicks with confidence 0 are excluded.

fields.Name: rasa.io - Contact External IDs
fields.UserQuestion: What are each rasa.io contact's IDs in our other systems?
fields.Description: Each contact's IDs in other systems (for example a CRM or AMS), with the email, for matching rasa.io contacts to records elsewhere.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Contact_External_Identifier joined to Contact on contact_id for the email. One row per contact and external ID.
